title: Why don't I qualify for the highest interest rate?
summary: Explains why customers may not qualify for the Gold Account’s highest interest rate: the balance must meet or exceed $10,000; otherwise eligibility can be affected. The highest APY is 5.5%, and it should display after meeting the threshold.
